table.name: TLGNS_SAP_BP_COMPANYCODE
table.description: Company code data received from SAP.

column.name: SAP_BP_COMPCD
column.description: PK. Technical key generated by Logon, does not have a corresponding attribute in SAP.

column.name: SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The business-partner to which this COMPANY CODE belongs to. (SAP: master_customer_basic_data.KUNNR, mapped).

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_COMPANYCODE_BS. The company code. (SAP: master_customer_companies_code.BUKRS, mapped).

column.name: POSTING_BLOCK
column.description: Indicates whether the customer is blocked for FI postings in the specific company code. Posting (FInance), is a standard accounting function to create business transactions in the general ledger. Logon will block the contract related to this company code. (SAP: master_customer_companies_code.SPERR, mapped).

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally. (SAP: master_customer_companies_code.LOEVM, mapped).
